skill.name: research-grants
skill.description: Draft and review research grant materials for NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA using agency-focused guidance and proposal templates.
skill.summary: Build structured federal research proposals with guidance for aims, impacts, methods, budgets, timelines, and review criteria.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All 71 static findings are false positives. The reconnaissance alerts match ordinary grant-writing prose, while command alerts match Markdown fences and inline file references. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or malicious execution behavior was found.

static_findings.snippet: This should be accessible to a broad audience including non-scientists. Avoid jargon.]
- **Clean Energy Transition**: Renewable energy, storage, grid modernization
- Avoid jargon (panel members may not be in your subfield)
- Acknowledge valid criticisms and explain how addressed
- **Substance Use and Mental Health**: Opioid crisis, addiction, mental health
- Scientific Review Officer (SRO): NIH staff, manages process
- ❌ No metrics: No way to assess success
"The proposed research is significant because it will define a novel mechanism of chemotherapy resis
- Specific gap or barrier to progress
- Why this gap is critical to address
For detailed methodology guidance by discipline, refer to `references/research_methods.md`.
For detailed budget guidance, refer to `references/budget_preparation.md`.
For detailed review criteria by agency, refer to `references/review_criteria.md`.
For detailed program guidance, refer to `references/funding_mechanisms.md`.
For detailed resubmission guidance, refer to `references/resubmission_strategies.md`.
- `references/nih_guidelines.md`: NIH mechanisms, review criteria, and submission requirements
- `references/doe_guidelines.md`: DOE programs, emphasis areas, and application procedures
- `references/darpa_guidelines.md`: DARPA BAAs, program offices, and proposal strategies
- `references/broader_impacts.md`: Strategies for compelling broader impacts statements
- `references/resubmission_strategies.md`: Responding to reviews and revising proposals
- `scripts/budget_calculator.py`: Calculate budgets with inflation and fringe
- Use accessible language (avoid jargon in opening sentences)
- Avoid over-interpreting or overstating preliminary findings
- Avoid jargon when possible; explain when necessary
- Use precise language (avoid vague terms like "several," "various")
- Addresses important problem or critical barrier to progress
- Show that you've thought through the research process

content.user_title: Build Stronger Federal Research Grant Proposals
content.value_statement: Researchers must align complex proposals with agency criteria, structure, and submission rules. This skill guides drafts for NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA applications.
actual_capabilities: Structures NSF project summaries around the overview, intellectual merit, and broader impacts.
Drafts NIH specific aims with the problem, gap, hypothesis, aims, outcomes, and impact.
Organizes DOE and DARPA narratives around mission relevance, milestones, transition plans, and budget alignment.
Develops sections for significance, innovation, methods, broader impacts, timelines, and risk mitigation.
Produces budget justification narratives for personnel, equipment, travel, and other direct costs.
Reviews proposal drafts against agency criteria, formatting reminders, and common writing mistakes.
limitations: Agency requirements can change, so users must verify every current solicitation and institutional policy.
The skill does not submit applications, access grant portals, or contact program officers.
The skill cannot validate scientific claims, preliminary data, citations, or financial calculations.
Referenced automation scripts and several supplemental guides are not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Develop a New Proposal
use_cases.description: Create a structured first draft that aligns the research plan with agency review criteria.

use_cases.title: Review Application Readiness
use_cases.description: Check narrative coverage, budget alignment, milestones, and required proposal sections before institutional review.

use_cases.title: Strengthen an Early Draft
use_cases.description: Turn research ideas into focused aims, significance statements, methods, and measurable outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Outline a Grant Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outline for my [agency] [section]. My topic is [topic], my objective is [objective], and my audience is [review panel].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for one proposal section

prompt_templates.title: Draft NIH Specific Aims
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an NIH specific aims page from this problem, knowledge gap, hypothesis, preliminary evidence, and three proposed aims: [details]. Mark unsupported claims.

prompt_templates.title: Build an NSF Narrative
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop an NSF proposal structure for [solicitation]. Connect objectives, methods, intellectual merit, broader impacts, milestones, team roles, and budget needs.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Mock Agency Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this [agency] draft against the attached solicitation and scoring criteria. Identify compliance gaps, weak evidence, feasibility risks, and prioritized revisions.

output_examples.input: Outline an NSF project summary for a five-year climate resilience study.
output_examples.output: A one-page structure with separate overview, intellectual merit, and broader impacts sections, followed by missing evidence and metrics.

output_examples.input: Strengthen three NIH aims about treatment resistance.
output_examples.output: Revised action-oriented aims with rationale, hypotheses, expected outcomes, dependencies, feasibility concerns, and alternative approaches.

output_examples.input: Review a DARPA technical narrative for milestone quality.
output_examples.output: A prioritized review covering measurable thresholds, phase gates, transition plans, technical risks, deliverables, and budget alignment.

best_practices: Provide the current solicitation, mechanism, deadline, page limits, and review criteria with each request.
Separate verified facts from assumptions, and replace every placeholder before institutional review.
Ask scientific, budget, compliance, and sponsored-research reviewers to validate the final application.
anti_patterns: Do not treat general agency guidance as a substitute for the current funding announcement.
Do not invent preliminary data, citations, collaborators, facilities, approvals, or budget rates.
Do not submit generated text without checking consistency across aims, methods, timeline, team, and budget.

faq.question: Which agencies does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It provides focused guidance for NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA research proposals.

faq.question: Can it choose the best funding opportunity?
faq.answer: It can compare supplied opportunities, but users must confirm eligibility and fit with official sources.

faq.question: Does it guarantee agency compliance?
faq.answer: No. Requirements change, and the current solicitation plus institutional guidance remain authoritative.

faq.question: Can it calculate a complete proposal budget?
faq.answer: It can organize and explain budget items, but users must verify rates, policies, totals, and cost sharing.

faq.question: Can it review an existing draft?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the draft, solicitation, and review criteria for a prioritized assessment.

faq.question: Does it submit proposals or access agency systems?
faq.answer: No. It creates and reviews content without accessing submission portals or external accounts.
